candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
Leave it to a central banker to fall for the "gold doesn't pay interest" error.

This shows why the mainstream sees higher rates as bad for gold (while the fallacy persists).

Fortunately, other central banks are still buying, not for yield, but for diversification.

candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text: FWIW, demand destruction isn't worrying OPEC...
